## Production Systems & Case Studies

### 1. ParkAOT (ParkOS) — Enterprise Smart Parking & Edge POS
- **Tech Stack**: ASP.NET Core 8 MVC, C#, PostgreSQL 16, SignalR WebSockets, FastReport .NET, Python YOLOv8 / PaddleOCR, ESC/POS Serial.
- **Architecture**: Lane-level POS terminal automating barrier gate relays, thermal receipt printing, user fare displays, and dynamic tariff evaluation (<5ms). Integrated with live SignalR hardware health dashboards and edge ANPR.

### 2. ANPR Multi-Lane Central Monitoring & Plaza Telemetry
- **Tech Stack**: ASP.NET Core Web API, PostgreSQL, SignalR, Leaflet.js, Windows Services.
- **Architecture**: 3-tier distributed monitoring topology (Lane Processing Unit &rarr; Toll Plaza Server &rarr; Central Command HQ) collecting real-time transaction logs and hardware heartbeats across 150+ live toll lanes.

### 3. Vehicle Re-ID & Visual Search Engine
- **Tech Stack**: Python 3.11, PyTorch, OSNet, FAISS (Facebook AI Similarity Search), OpenCV, FastAPI.
- **Architecture**: Deep metric learning pipeline generating 512-dimensional vehicle embeddings. Utilizes FAISS index for sub-15ms vector retrieval across multi-camera highway corridors even during license plate occlusion.

### 4. NEXTGEN Consolidated Highway ATMS
- **Tech Stack**: C#, .NET Framework / .NET Core, PostgreSQL, Windows Services, Leaflet GIS, RDLC Reporting.
- **Architecture**: Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA) unifying roadside ITS subsystems: Variable Message Signs (VMS), Automatic Traffic Classifiers (ATCC), Emergency Call Boxes (ECB), Meteorological Weather Sensors, and PTZ CCTV.

### 5. Video Management System (VMS) & Multi-Camera PTZ Engine
- **Tech Stack**: C#, ASP.NET Core, MediaMTX, WebRTC (WHEP), ONVIF Protocol, H.264 / H.265 RTSP.
- **Architecture**: Real-time IP camera management supporting ONVIF WS-Discovery, PTZ joystick control, sub-200ms multi-camera live grid streaming, and synchronized historical video playback.

### 6. Edge-Based ANPR & Automatic Traffic Classifier (ATCC)
- **Tech Stack**: Python, YOLOv8, PaddleOCR, ByteTrack, Raspberry Pi 5, NCNN, OpenVINO, Hugging Face Spaces.
- **Architecture**: Edge computer vision pipeline deployed on Raspberry Pi 5 achieving 15+ FPS. Fine-tuned PaddleOCR on 5,000+ Indian vehicle plates achieving 98% accuracy. Live interactive demo deployed on Hugging Face Spaces.

### 7. ATMS PWA & Mobile Toll Field Operator Console
- **Tech Stack**: Progressive Web Apps (PWA), Service Workers, JavaScript ES6+, .NET Core Web API, PostgreSQL.
- **Architecture**: Offline-first mobile diagnostic web application for roadside technicians to trigger gate relays, view camera snapshots, and record incident logs during network disconnects.
